rules.desc: Application Layer Firewall must be enabled (global_state >= 1)
rules.query: SELECT global_state, stealth_enabled FROM alf LIMIT 1
rules.lua:
if #results == 0 then return false end
local state = tonumber(tostring(results[1].global_state or ""))
return state ~= nil and state >= 1

rules.desc: Gatekeeper assessments must be enabled (macOS code-signing enforcement)
rules.query: SELECT assessments_enabled, dev_id_enabled FROM gatekeeper LIMIT 1
rules.lua:
if #results == 0 then return false end
local enabled = tostring(results[1].assessments_enabled or "")
return enabled == "1" or string.lower(enabled) == "true"

rules.query: SELECT de.encrypted AS encrypted FROM mounts m JOIN disk_encryption de ON m.device = de.name WHERE m.path = '/' LIMIT 1
rules.lua:
if #results == 0 then return false end
local enc = tostring(results[1].encrypted or "")
return enc == "1" or string.lower(enc) == "true"

rules.desc: System Integrity Protection must be enabled
rules.query: SELECT enabled, enabled_nvram FROM sip_config WHERE config_flag = 'sip' LIMIT 1
rules.lua:
if #results == 0 then return false end
local enabled = tostring(results[1].enabled or "")
return enabled == "1" or string.lower(enabled) == "true"
